Hi Lena — thanks for sending everything over and for the clear note on legal name. Two quick asks from our side so we can finish vendor-master normalization and avoid PO/invoice mismatches: 

1) Can you confirm the exact pay-to name that should appear on invoices and on our AP system? You indicated "Merchant Systems, Inc." on the W-9, but sometimes the legal entity line must exactly match our ERP vendor name (capitalization/punctuation matters).
2) Please confirm whether invoices should be routed to procure@merchantsys.com or to a specific AP inbox per site. We prefer a single canonical invoice recipient when possible.
3) If you have a remittance/ACH file sample or bank letter, that speeds up our ACH onboarding; otherwise we can accept bank details later once the vendor record is created.

Looping in Marissa (AP onboarding) and Kimberly (vendor master operations) to complete the profile and map PO routing. Marissa/Kim — if the W-9 EIN matches Merchant Systems, Inc., can you start the vendor creation and flag any name-normalization items back to Lena?

Thanks — I’ll hold on finalizing the vendor record until we get confirmation on the pay-to name and invoice recipient.
